<!-- en -->
v0.1.4 is a small maintenance release that makes recovery from non-standard installations safer and clearer.

### Highlights
- `token-usage update --force` can explicitly replace two otherwise-protected installation states: an official binary re-signed locally (including a tagged `go install` build) and a local `Version = dev` build. The replacement is still downloaded from the official Release and verified with SHA256 and a staged `--version` check, restoring normal automatic updates afterwards.
- Safety boundaries remain intact: symlinked copies and non-official tags cannot be forced, and `--check --force` is rejected because checks are read-only.
- The English and Chinese README, installation guide, CLI reference, architecture guide, and contributor guide are streamlined and kept in sync, including the new recovery path for re-signed and source-built binaries.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.4 是一个小型维护版本，让非标准安装形态的恢复路径更安全、更清晰。

### 亮点
- `token-usage update --force` 可显式替换两类原本受保护的安装状态：本地重签的官方二进制（包括指定 tag 的 `go install` 构建产物）与本地 `Version = dev` 构建。替换仍从官方 Release 下载，并通过 SHA256 与 stage `--version` 校验；完成后恢复正常自动更新。
- 安全边界保持不变：软链副本和非官方 tag 不能强制覆盖；`--check --force` 因检查必须只读而被明确拒绝。
- 中英文 README、安装指南、CLI 参考、架构说明与贡献指南已精简并保持同步，包含重签或源码构建二进制的新恢复路径。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。
